reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly supports the formation of a denser oxide layer and best corrosion resistance at 10.2 at.% Al, but provides no data on mechanical integrity after oxidation, leaving that premise unsupported.
premises: AlNbTiZr MEA coatings with ~10 at.% Al form a denser oxide layer (Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2) than coatings with other Al contents
This denser oxide layer provides the best corrosion resistance and minimum oxygen penetration depth
The optimal Al content for these properties is near 10 at.%
The coating's mechanical integrity is maintained at this composition
